name: United Capital Plc
source: United Capital Plc audited consolidated financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025, Five-Year Financial Summary income statement for the Group page 70, printed in thousands of naira; values stored below as absolute naira. Revenue is the printed Gross earnings, Operating Expenses the printed Gross operating expenses and Operating Profit (EBIT) the printed Operating profit before income tax. Cost of Sales, Gross Profit and Net Finance Costs are not printed for this issuer and are left absent. The previously stored FY2023 to FY2021 revenue and profit values did not reconcile with the audited summary and were replaced.

rows.label: Income Tax
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Profit Before Tax - Income Tax = Net Profit, and the column ties with it positive

rows.label: ROE (%)
rows.derivedCellFormula: ROE (%) = Net Profit / Total Equity x 100

rows.label: Debt to Equity
rows.derivedCellFormula: Debt to Equity = Total Liabilities / Total Equity
